Cantrips are simple spells that can be cast without the need for a spell focus. They are the most basic form of magic, and are the first spells I will learn.

Cantrips are cast by right-clicking with an empty hand. I can also bind a cantrip to a hotkey by opening the manaweaving UI and pressing the hotkey I want to bind it to.

I can also use the 'C' key to cycle through the different cantrips I have unlocked.

I can also use the 'V' key to show the cantrip I have selected.

Cantrips are very useful for quick and simple tasks, and can be used in a variety of situations.

I can also use cantrips to create more complex spells by combining them with other manaweaves.

The transmutation cantrip allows me to transmute blocks in the world. I can use this to turn one block into another, such as turning stone into arcane stone.

I can also use this cantrip to transmute items in my inventory. I can do this by right-clicking on the item I want to transmute.

I can also use this cantrip to transmute blocks in a 3x3x3 area around me. I can do this by sneaking and right-clicking.

This cantrip is very useful for quickly changing the world around me, and can be used to create a variety of different blocks and items.

The light cantrip allows me to create a light source at a targeted location. I can use this to light up dark areas, or to create a beacon to mark a location.

I can also use this cantrip to remove a light source that I have created. I can do this by right-clicking on the light source.

This cantrip is very useful for exploring dark areas, and can be used to create a variety of different light sources.

The ignite cantrip allows me to set fire to a targeted location. I can use this to light a fire, or to burn an enemy.

I can also use this cantrip to extinguish a fire that I have created. I can do this by right-clicking on the fire.

This cantrip is very useful for setting fire to things, and can be used to create a variety of different fire sources.

The extinguish cantrip allows me to extinguish a fire at a targeted location. I can use this to put out a fire, or to remove a fire from an enemy.

This cantrip is very useful for putting out fires, and can be used to remove a variety of different fire sources.

The force cantrip allows me to push or pull entities with a small force. I can use this to move entities around, or to push or pull an enemy.

This cantrip is very useful for moving entities around, and can be used to create a variety of different force effects.
